title: Measure shortest directed hop distances
statement: From vertex 0, compute the shortest number of edges to each reachable vertex. Return their distance sum, largest distance, and count of unreachable vertices. For an empty graph, all output fields are zero. Every edge costs one hop.
constraints: Vertices are 0..limit-1; endpoints are valid. limit=0 implies no edges. Directed cycles, duplicates and self-loops are allowed.
Use the exact declared Entry and Report record fields and solve signature. Return all three Report fields; do not mutate the caller's records.
All arithmetic fits signed int64; there are at most 30 records. limit is in [0, 30]. Return fresh results; no I/O, tests, exceptions, panic, or static-check bypasses.

jett.signature:
namespace benchmark

struct Entry:
    source: int64
    target: int64

struct Report:
    distance_sum: int64
    farthest: int64
    unreachable: int64

function solve(view rows: list[Entry], limit: int64) returns Report
